Post Date: 2020-10-21T10:58:43Z

Title: Query from distributed tables with sharded data return separate result for each shard
Description: **Describe the bug**
Select aggregates from disributed table produce unexpected results.
**How to reproduce**
* Which ClickHouse server version to use
Tested on 
1) 
```
+----------------+----------------------------------------+
|name            |value                                   |
+----------------+----------------------------------------+
|VERSION_FULL    |ClickHouse 20.3.11.97                   |
|VERSION_DESCRIBE|v20.3.11.97-stable                      |
|VERSION_INTEGER |20003011                                |
|VERSION_GITHASH |952efc395509c10081e8c1b836ebb5c2e0f898fa|
|VERSION_REVISION|54433                                   |
+----------------+----------------------------------------+

```

2)
```
+----------------+----------------------------------------+
|name            |value                                   |
+----------------+----------------------------------------+
|VERSION_FULL    |ClickHouse 20.7.2.30                    |
|VERSION_DESCRIBE|v20.7.2.30-stable                       |
|VERSION_INTEGER |20007002                                |
|VERSION_GITHASH |e0529c753f9dd4fc27e38f2f25a14d50beedda65|
|VERSION_REVISION|54437                                   |
+----------------+----------------------------------------+
```
* Non-default settings, if any
prefer_localhost_replica 0
* `CREATE TABLE` statements for all tables involved
```
create table test
(
    date Date,
    key  String
) engine MergeTree() partition by date order by key;
create table test_dist as test engine Distributed('cubes', default, test, date);
```
* Sample data for all these tables, use [clickhouse-obfuscator]
On shard 1: 
```
insert into test values ('2020-01-01', '1');
insert into test values ('2020-01-01', '2');
```
On shard 2
```
insert into test values ('2020-01-01', '1', 1);
insert into test values ('2020-01-01', '2', 1);
insert into test values ('2020-01-03', '3', 1);
```
* Queries to run that lead to unexpected result
```
select toMonday(date) mnt, uniq(key)
from test_dist
where mnt = '2019-12-30'
group by mnt;
```

Result:
```
+----------+---------+
|mnt       |uniq(key)|
+----------+---------+
|2019-12-30|2        |
|2019-12-30|3        |
+----------+---------+

```

**Expected behavior**
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.
Expected single row to return with 3 uniq(key)
```
+----------+---------+
|mnt       |uniq(key)|
+----------+---------+
|2019-12-30|3        |
+----------+---------+
```
